comment: Enemy perception of the squad before a fight (patrols / search, user request 2026-10-06). Read at game start (Data/EnemyPerception.h); a missing key keeps the built-in default (AI/PerceptionRules.cpp). Distances in meters, angles in degrees (half-angle of the field of view), times in seconds. smell_radius_m only counts for FROST_HOUND (6 m since 2026-10-18; hound scent: every wall between the nose and the operative multiplies it by smell_occlusion_per_wall, a scent only ALERTS the hound - it sniffs sniff_seconds, then follows the scent at scent_follow_speed_fraction x its patrol pace; it detects only within smell_detect_m in open air or by sight; a lost scent is investigated scent_search_seconds within scent_sweep_radius_m, docs/design/STEALTH_LURE.md). Footstep radii lowered 2026-10-06 (user playtest); every wall between the enemy and the operative multiplies the footstep radius by hearing_occlusion_per_wall (optional per archetype, default 0.5). Placed charges / traps use the trap alert radius (20 m) and start a SEARCH; detection by sight / hearing / smell starts the fight.

height_sight.comment: Sight range from a height (game designer 2026-11-02, L_Gen_Depot_1; the NUMBERS ARE PENDING the user's confirmation). ONE model for the squad AND the armed human enemies (the Marksman, the PMC fighters, every enemy that climbs ladders); beasts keep their own senses. The observer's height level = floor(eye height above the ground below him / level_step_m) (the lowest surface straight under his feet - a roof's hall floor and the street below count, not the absolute Z; in the -3 m cut the cut floor is his ground: level 0). Sight range x (1 + bonus_per_level x level) for level >= 1, at most max_multiplier; level <= 0 = x1 (never less than on the ground). Defaults: +1 (3 m) x1.25, +2 (6 m) x1.5, +3 (9 m) x1.75. Walls / roof edges hide what they hide at every height (3D traces). Console Codex.Sight.HeightRange 0 = off (A/B).

sight_conditions.comment: Sight range by the conditions (user request 2026-11-04 on L_Gen_Depot_1: 'on a clear day the cone should cover practically everything visible; night cuts it drastically whatever the weather; snowfall / blizzard / fog reduce it; the same for the enemies'; the NUMBERS ARE PENDING the user's confirmation). squad_base_range_m = the squad's clear-day range on the ground (was a flat 60 m); human_enemy_range_multiplier = the armed humans (Marksman, PMC, every ladder climber) x this over their archetype sight_range_m below (one model: they see as far as the squad); beasts keep their rows. Every observer's range (the squad, the humans, the beasts) x weather x time_of_day: the weather blended through a transition (the weather amounts), the time of day by the sun's elevation (day at / above day_sun_elevation_deg, twilight at the horizon, night at / below night_sun_elevation_deg, linear between: no pops). The height bonus (height_sight) multiplies on top. There is no LightSnow / Fog weather state yet (the ladder is Clear / Overcast / Snowfall / Blizzard): light_snow 0.75 and fog 0.4 are reserved for them and unused. Console Codex.Sight.Conditions 0 = no weather / time multiplier, Codex.Sight.LongRange 0 = the old 60 m and x1 humans (A/B).

lure.comment: Stealth lure (user decisions 2026-10-18, docs/design/STEALTH_LURE.md): WHISTLE = a noise at the operative, THROW = a stone / bolt / cartridge, noise at the impact. Infinite, per-operative cooldown, only while exploring undetected. Every patrol / guard enemy within the radius (walls cut it like footsteps: hearing_occlusion_per_wall) investigates the point for investigate_seconds, sweeping within investigate_sweep_radius_m, then returns to its route / post.
